items.text: Look at those dark clouds — it is going to rain soon.
We bought the tickets — we are going to watch the Chengdu concert.
She is in her ninth month — she is going to have a baby.
I practised English daily — I am going to get a better grade.
The meeting starts in five minutes — I am going to be late!
There is ice on the bridge — the bus is going to drive slowly.
I put on my shoes — I am going to run along the riverside Greenway.
The sign says the museum closes at 5 — we are going to miss the entry!
He has rehearsed ten times — he is going to sound confident on stage.
The kitchen light is on — Mom is going to cook dinner.
We saved money for months — we are going to buy a laptop.
The river looks polluted — volunteers are going to clean it next Saturday.
Your eyes are red — you are going to get sick if you don't rest.
Registration closes at midnight — I am going to finish the form now.
Sports day is next Friday — we are going to practise relays after class.
The phone is ringing — I'll answer it.
I think technology will change our classrooms in five years.
Don't worry — I promise I won't tell anyone your secret.
I'm thirsty — I'll get some water from the kitchen.
Maybe robots will help farmers pick fruit in the future.
If you visit Chengdu in spring, you'll love the flowers along the streets.
I don't know this word, but I'll look it up after class.
You'll feel better after you talk to someone you trust.
Who spilled the juice? — Never mind, I'll wipe the floor.
Press the green button and the screen will show your score.
I'm sorry I'm late — I'll treat everyone to milk tea after school.
We don't know the score yet, but we believe our team will win.
It's noisy here — I'll move to the library to finish homework.
Winter in Chengdu will probably feel wetter than you expect.
Hold on — I'll send you the link as soon as I find it.
The doctor will see you now.
The nurse will take your temperature first.
The manager will be with you in a minute.
We'll bring your meal right away.
I'll walk you to the classroom — this way, please.
Don't worry — I'll stay with you until your parents arrive.
The librarian will help you find that book.
We will respect your privacy and your choice.
